51450179.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to recombinant N-terminal FLAG/His6-tagged human vanin-1 expressed in CHO cells assessed as dissociation constant by surface plasmon resonance analysis

original_paragraph.SPR Binding Assays: SPR Binding Assays. Experiments were conducted using a BIACORE T200 (GE Healthcare) using CMS sensor chips. Neutravidin (Pierce) was added to the CMS channels using amine coupling (GE Healthcare) (pH 5 at 25 °C) to an average density of 25,000 resonance units (RU). Biotinylated vanin-1 was next immobilized (75 μg/mL at 5 μL/min) in a buffer (20 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 150 mM NaCl) to a final density of 1000–8000 RU depending on the affinity of the compound tested. No protein was added to channel 1. Compounds were prepared in neat DMSO solutions; each compound was tested at 12 concentration points (twofold dilutions) centered on the compound IC50. The final assay buffer was 20 mM HEPES, pH 7.5, 150 mM NaCl, and 0.5% DMSO. Experiments were subtracted from channel 1 and a zero-concentration buffer blank prior to analysis. Dissociation equilibrium constants (KD), association constants (kon), and dissociation constants (koff) were determined using a binary association model within the software (T200 BIA Eval) supplied by the manufacturer and are reported in Table 4.
